C0.quote: the aggregation of individual preferences into a collective choice
C0.note: Studies symmetry groups (anonymity/neutrality) of social preference functions aggregating individual linear orders into a collective linear order.

C1.quote: which permutation groups may arise as anonymity, neutrality and symmetry group
C1.note: Group-theoretic characterisation of attainable anonymity/neutrality/symmetry levels of spfs.

C2.3.quote: each individual i ∈ H expresses her preferences through some pi ∈ Sn
C2.3.note: Input is described as the individuals' preferences, a held attitude, although no separate object is defined.
